A0-M1-U1-L01.objectives: Greet and take leave with hello/hi/goodbye/bye; introduce yourself with I am + name; address a pictured person with You are + name.
A0-M1-U1-L01.notes: P-01: complete picture-led draft; author and automated audits only; independent review/validation and learner testing pending. Eight words; G003 supports the single main I am/You are name frame. Listening is a helper-read script, not recorded audio.

A0-M1-U1-L02.objectives: Refer to the speaker's and listener's name with my/your; use My name is/Your name is + name; ask What is your name? as a fixed chunk and answer it.
A0-M1-U1-L02.notes: P-01: complete picture-led draft; author and automated audits only; independent review/validation and learner testing pending. Five words, including explicitly advanced what/is.
